summary: Verified git unshallow fix in /app for GitHub push 'did not receive expected object dd2132dc...' error. All 5 checks passed: repo not shallow (.git/shallow absent), dd2132dc is a valid commit and ancestor of HEAD, git fsck --connectivity-only exit 0 with 0 missing, git rev-list --objects --all exit 0 with no missing errors, simulated push to fresh bare repo /tmp/pushtest.git succeeded (HEAD 8ba0bba -> main, bare repo fsck clean) and bare repo deleted. /app HEAD, branches and remotes unchanged. GET /api/ returns 200 {"message":"Central Inventory API Proxy"}; frontend redirects to /login and renders Central Inventory sign-in page.
action_items: None. User can retry 'Save to GitHub'. Note: only remote configured in /app is 'repo' -> parth-mygenie/central_inventory.git; the Emergent Save-to-GitHub flow handles the target remote itself. Untracked .emergent/cron/ exists (pre-existing, not touched).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Git repo in /app is fully unshallowed (12 commits on HEAD 8ba0bba). Push simulation done via temp bare repo, cleaned up. No code or git state modified.
rca of the issue: Shallow clone (--depth=1) meant the pack sent to GitHub referenced parent dd2132dc which wasn't present locally; remote index-pack failed. git fetch --unshallow restored full history; push to empty bare repo now succeeds.
